# Accommodation

•

**Accommodation**

Tropica presents a variety of accommodations that skillfully blend contemporary style with traditional Fijian architecture.

Opt for one of our west-facing Beachfront Pool Bures to savour the unrivaled proximity to the ocean. Relax on your private beachside deck as you watch the tide roll in just meters from your doorstep.

Alternatively, choose one of our Sanctuary Suites, perched on higher ground and accessed by stairs, offering partial ocean views, spacious comfort, and your own private pool.

For those with an adventurous spirit, each of our rooms offers private outdoor raintree showers, providing the opportunity to experience a refreshing shower beneath the starry night sky.

## Sanctuary Pool Suite

Inspired by the tropical sanctuary they overlook, our seven Sanctuary Pool Suites are modern and contemporary. Being 70sqm, their generous space includes an open-plan bedroom and living area, and each comes with a private plunge pool.

VIEW DETAILS

## Beachfront Bure

Wake to the sounds of water lapping on the beach in one of our traditional Beachfront Bures. With high ceilings and open-plan interiors, these 60sqm bures are spacious and stylishly appointed, blending contemporary island style with Fijian culture.

VIEW DETAILS

## Beachfront Pool Bure

Our 10 Beachfront Pool Bures with their own private plunge pools are set only metres from the water’s edge and are surrounded by lush tropical gardens. Perfect for honeymooners and couples, these spacious 70sqm bures are stylishly appointed and ready for romance. These bures feature exclusive inclusions…

VIEW DETAILS

## Deluxe Pool Bure

Our Deluxe Pool Bure is designed specifically for romance and relaxation, making it the ideal choice for couples seeking comfort and privacy. This spacious, high-end bure provides a luxurious retreat.

VIEW DETAILS
